options.text: Hot fluid is denser and sinks
Hot fluid expands, becomes less dense, and rises while cooler, denser fluid sinks to replace it
Particles vibrate and pass energy to neighbours

questions.explanation: In convection, heating causes a fluid to expand and become less dense. The less dense, warmer fluid rises, and the surrounding cooler, denser fluid sinks to take its place. This creates a convection current that transfers heat through the fluid.
